deletionPolicy.description:
Defaults to `Orphan`: deleting the CR never deletes the
organization (Forgejo also refuses while it still owns repos).

name.description: Organization name (its URL slug). Changing it renames in place.

ownerRef.description:
`ForgejoUser` that becomes the organization's first owner. Only read
at creation; without it the operator's admin account owns it.

repoAdminChangeTeamAccess.description: Let repository admins change which teams can access their repo.

visibility.description: Visibility of a Forgejo user or organization.
